llm.summary: This skill is a narrowly scoped Chinese teacher assistant for drafting student progress and renewal reports, with clear limits on student data use and no evidence of hidden execution or message sending.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for a Chinese Mainland Chinese K12 independent-teacher workflow; the Chinese-language schema and shared guidance fit that stated deployment context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Inspected artifacts are Markdown and JSON only, with no executable scripts, dependencies, remote payload retrieval, or install-time mutation behavior found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions require a specific student alias before reading data, prohibit cross-student scans, limit reads to listed fields, require parent-facing consent checks, and forbid sending messages, changing student status, or deleting student profiles.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The only declared write target is progressEvidence[] for teacher-confirmed stage evidence, with documented view, correction, deletion, pause, sharing-control, and export controls; it does not write parent communication logs or core student-card fields.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill reads sensitive longitudinal learning records for minors and course-package data, but this is coherent with generating evidence-based stage reports and renewal suggestions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, users should be comfortable with the skill reading one named student's learning records, homework follow-ups, course-package status, and consent fields to draft reports. Parent-facing content should only be generated when the consent fields allow it, and teachers remain responsible for manually sending any report or renewal message.
llm.findings:
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded after artifact review: the Chinese-only schema is consistent with the package metadata and shared platform convention stating the library is for Chinese Mainland Chinese K12 use, not an unsupported forced-language behavior.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied static scan reported no results; workspace inspection found no hidden commands, remote execution, tool hijacking, or persistence outside the documented progressEvidence[] write path.
